text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 21 bags of the amino acid injection providing 4.8 days of supply at 4.4 bags per day. Corvale General holds 63 bags of the same formulation providing 14 days of supply at 4.5 bags per day. No public FDA shortage signal exists for this product at our facilities.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include valine, lysine, histidine, isoleucine, leucine, phenylalanine, threonine, methionine, tryptophan, alanine, glycine, arginine, proline, glutamic acid, serine, aspartic acid and tyrosine as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Inventory at Corvale East is below the internal target of 7 days on hand. Corvale General remains above target. Standard procurement should continue with heightened monitoring at the East campus.

Recommended actions:
1. Increase order frequency for Corvale East to achieve at least 7 days on hand; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Implement daily inventory reconciliation at both sites; requires Operations Manager approval.
3. Add this product to the weekly shortage watch list for P&T Committee review; requires Committee Chair approval.

Not recommended: Allocation restrictions, alternative product sourcing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
